claims.statement: For the explicit systematic 333,333,334-bit field-cube product and its radius-47 component decoder, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 390125041029746637/1000000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same product and radius-47 decoder uses at most the integer W=13423322060905493287338313779110058800000132956489566120677370 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(203063/1000).
